sentences.text:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Mohd. Yousuf Wani, Judge
 Order

04.11.2024 Mr. Suneel Malhotra, learned GA appearing on behalf of Respondent No. 1 to 3 submits that the requisite funds along with the formal indent has already been submitted to Respondent No.
4 for initiating acquisition proceedings in accordance with law for the time being in force.

Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Sr. AAG appearing on behalf of Respondent No. 4 assures this Court that the proceedings shall be initiated at the earliest and taken to logical end within the period prescribed under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation Act, 2013.

Meanwhile, the Collector Land Acquisition shall file status report with regard to the steps taken in this regard and shall also place on record the assessment of the rental compensation in terms of the earlier order.
